section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study examining the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women (N = 228). It reports a mean age of 19.89, supports a unidimensional BAS structure, and finds ethnic identity positively associated with body appreciation; no BMI or BMI–BAS correlations are reported in the abstract.
